claim: Changing only the executable build revision no longer invalidates the Native runtime unit binary.

conditions.kache: 1.2.1, local artifact cache, incremental routes disabled
conditions.host_contention: Other hosted workloads were active. This comparison proves invalidation versus no compile, not isolated compiler throughput.

controls.observed_field: An added assertion reads the actual public fingerprint's source_revision and compares it with a runtime expectation. Baseline reports each compiled revision; candidate reports the documented unstamped library receipt.

decision: Attach optional source provenance in the owning executable. Preserve the CLI version receipt and keep Native content identity independent of build stamps.
limitations: The temporary assertion changes the unit source identically within each arm. Baseline and candidate seed compiles have different cache warmth and are not a throughput comparison.
This proves one revision-only transition through the complete Native unit binary. Production source edits must still rebuild it.
The CLI and the workspace CI feature graph require independent qualification; this is not an end-to-end CI or p90 measurement.
